newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products dip except steady heating oil.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products dip except steady heating oil.

text.p: NWE oil products dipped on Monday morning, except gas oil which was virtually unchanged, dealers said.
Gasoline was about $1 a tonne lower. Prompt eurograde barges were offered at $194/$195, first half May deliveries at $196.50/$197 fob Rotterdam.
May swaps' value was steady at $195.50 fob ARA, although the bid-offer range widened.
Heating oil barges were almost stable as prompt gas oil futures dipped by a mere 25 cents.
Prompt and first half May offers were at May IPE +$1/+$1.25 fob Rotterdam.
Low Rhine water levels meant barges were hard to find and freight rates were high. However, German demand was poor.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were $1 a tonne lower. One barge traded at $82 fob Rotterdam. Late morning offers were at that level, with bids $1 lower.
Initial estimates were of bunker demand below 10,000 tonnes. -- Philip Blenkinsop, Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5004
